sentences.en: Basalt is a type of rock that forms when lava solidifies.
sentences.zh: 玄武岩是一种岩石，形成于熔岩凝固。

sentences.en: The dictator reorganised the country's leadership line-up in order to solidify his power base.
sentences.zh: 独裁者重新组织了国家的领导层以巩固自己的权力基础。

sentences.en: The team’s trust has solidified over years of working together.
sentences.zh: 这支队伍通过多年的合作建立了深厚的互信。
